TEXT_DICT.EnableLighting: Allow Lightning and Frost Energy Orbs to replace each other (requires restart)
TEXT_DICT.EnableDark: Allow Dark and Plasma Energy Orbs to replace each other (requires restart)
TEXT_DICT.EnableCalm: Allow Calm and Anger stances to replace each other (requires restart)
TEXT_DICT.EnableRandomStance: Allow exiting current stance to be replaced by entering random stance (requires restart)
TEXT_DICT.EnableYishang: Allow applying Vulnerable and applying Weak to replace each other (requires restart)
TEXT_DICT.EnableStrength: Allow gaining Strength and gaining Dexterity to replace each other (requires restart)
